links.outcome: Diagnostic concordance of deployed LLM configurations on pediatric tumor cases
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o at least partial concordance 27/35 (77.1%), IHC accuracy 74.4%; GPT-5 19/33 (57.6%), IHC accuracy 60.7%; p<0.05 between models.
links.quote: GPT-5 showed 19/33 (57.6%) concordance (total and mean 25, 0.76), highest in SRBCT (87.5%) and IHC accuracy 60.7%.

links.outcome: Performance change between successive model versions on same task
links.effect: Newer GPT-5 scored lower than ChatGPT-4o: 57.6% vs 77.1% concordance, mean score 0.76 vs 1.2 (p<0.05).

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark evaluating ChatGPT-4o and GPT-5 diagnostic and reporting capabilities on multimodal pediatric tumor case data without evaluating specific deployment guardrails or practices.
